 We Know Beauty Of Joseon For Its Sunscreen. Its Serums Deserve A Conversation, Too
 Your skin has moods. Sometimes it wants a little glow; sometimes it has opinions about dark spots. Beauty of Joseon's two serums cater to different concerns at Nykaaland 2026.
 22 Oct 2026 | Team ELLE You know the feeling. It is a humid afternoon; you have spent the day commuting through the city, and when you catch a glimpse of yourself in the mirror, your skin looks a little duller than it did that morning. Perhaps dark spots seem more noticeable, or your complexion looks uneven, even though you follow your skincare routine. You reach for your trusted sunscreen because protecting your skin is non-negotiable, but you also wonder what else you can add to your routine to bring back that healthy-looking glow. 
 Beauty of Joseon is best known for its cult-favourite sunscreens, drawing on traditional Korean beauty rituals and modern skincare formulations. At 2026, taking place from 23 to 25 October, the brand will showcase its ‘Glow with Beauty of Joseon’ concept, spotlighting two serums for different skin concerns and introducing Indian beauty lovers to its skincare range beyond sunscreen. 
 Find Your Glow 
 Skin concerns vary, from dullness and uneven texture to dark spots and excess oil. Beauty of Joseon’s Glow Serum and Glow Deep Serum cater to different needs. 
 The Glow Serum: Propolis + Niacinamide is formulated for brighter-looking skin and the appearance of smoother texture and refined pores. It combines propolis extract, which helps hydrate and soothe the skin, niacinamide to support oil-moisture balance, and 0.5% BHA for gentle exfoliation. Its honey-like texture absorbs without leaving a sticky finish and is gentle on your skin. 
 When Your Skin Has Other Plans 
 For those concerned about uneven skin tone, the Glow Deep Serum: Rice + Alpha-Arbutin is formulated to help the skin look radiant. Drawing on traditional Korean beauty rituals that used rice water, the lightweight formula combines rice bran water, which helps maintain skin moisture, with alpha-arbutin to improve dullness. 
 A Little Reminder for Your Daily Routine 
 Whichever serum you choose, remember that consistency matters more than having an overcrowded bathroom shelf. Both serums can be used in the morning and evening, allowing you to build a routine around your skin's needs. During the day, always finish with sunscreen, especially if you spend time outdoors in India's sun and humidity. 
 From dullness after a long day outdoors to uneven skin tone, the brand’s Glow Serum and Glow Deep Serum address different skin concerns. Both are available on Nykaa for those looking to explore their ingredients and find a suitable addition to their skincare routine.
